book.name: Sekan Kranakuls
book.title: Sekan Kranakuls Ola Stori Blanga Ola King Blanga Juda

content: Deibin gibit det Serramoni Pleis langa YAWEI

Wal wen King Salaman bin binij det preya, bigwan faiya bin kamdan brom top en barnimap det sekrifais ofring weya deibin gibit langa YAWEI, en det brabli braitwan lait blanga YAWEI bin braitinimap det Serramoni Pleis.
Dumaji det Serramoni Pleis bin brabli braitwan garram lait, detlot serramoni men nomo bin go insaid langa det pleis na.

Wen detlot Isreil pipul bin luk det faiya bin kamdan brom top en det brabli braitwan lait bin braitinimap det Serramoni Pleis, olabat holot bin baudan en weship langa YAWEI en preisimbat im, dumaji imbin brabli gudbala en imbin laigim olabat olagijawan.
Wal King Salaman en ola pipul bin gibit ola sekrifais langa YAWEI.
Imbin sekrifais 22,000 buligi en 120,000 ship blanga feloship ofring. Lagijat na im en ola pipul bin gibit det Serramoni Pleis langa YAWEI.

Wal ola serramonimen bin ol jandap langa olabat ron pleis, en deibin luk langa ola Libai pipul en deibin preisimbat YAWEI garram detlot myusik ebrijing weya King Deibid bin gibit. Deibin singim det song gulum Im Laigim Olabat Olagijawan, laik Deibid bin dalim olabat. Detlot serramonimen bin blowim detlot longwan wisul en ola pipul bin jandap.

Wal King Salaman bin meigim seikridwan det midul pat langa det kotyad, det pleis weya bin lida langa det Serramoni Pleis, en deya na deibin gibit detlot holbit barnapwan sekrifais ofring, sid daga ofring, en det fetpat brom detlot feloship ofring. Imbin dum dijan, dumaji detlot ofring bin tumatj langa det teibul blanga ofring deibin meigim brom kopa.

Wal King Salaman en ola Isreil pipul bin abum det speshalwan serramoni gulum Hampi fo 7 dei. Detmatj pipul bin deya. Deibin kaman longwei brom nowathwei raidap langa det jampap gulum Heimath en brom sauthwei raidap langa det boda blanga Ijip.
Deibin jidan fo 7 dei blanga gibit det teibul blanga ofring langa YAWEI en deibin jidan 7 dei mowa blanga det serramoni gulum Hampi. Langa det laswan dei deibin abum det binijimapwan serramoni,

en langa det namba 23 dei blanga det namba 7 manth, King Salaman bin jandimwei detlot pipul brabli gudbinjiwei langa olabat kemp, dumaji YAWEI bin gibit ola gudbala ting langa im pipul olabat, en langa King Deibid en langa King Salaman.
God bin kamat langa King Salaman igin
Wal wen King Salaman bin binij bildimbat det Serramoni Pleis en im bigwan haus gudwei,
YAWEI bin kamat langa im naitaim. Imbin tok langa im, “Aibin irrim yu preya en aibin pikimat dijan Serramoni Pleis weya ola pipul garra gibit sekrifais ofring langa mi.
Enitaim ai holdimbek det rein o jandim insek blanga dagat ola sid daga, o jandim nogudwan siknis langa main pipul olabat,

if dei prei langa mi en sori miselp en stap dumbat ola nogudbala ting, wal ai garra irrim brom top, en ai garra larramgo olabat fri brom olabat nogudbalawei, en meigim det kantri blanga olabat abum loda gudwan ebrijing igin.
Ai garra wotjimbat dijan Serramoni Pleis en ai garra jidan redi blanga irrim ola preya weya olabat garra tok iya,
dumaji aibin pikimat dijan pleis blanga main en iya na olabat garra weshipbat mi olagijawan. Ai garra wotjimbat im en lukaftumbat im olataim.
If yu wek langa mi trubalawei laik yu dedi Deibid bin dum, en duwit langa main lowa en dum ebrijing ai dalim yu,
ai garra kipum det pramis aibin meigim garram yu dedi Deibid wen aibin pramis im bigininimob garra jidan bos blanga ola Isreil pipul olataim.
Bat if yu en yu pipul olabat nomo teiknodis en duwit langa ola lowa aibin gibit yu, en yu weship najalot drimin,

wal ai garra jandimwei yumob brom dijan kantri weya aibin gibit langa yu, en ai garra libum dijan Serramoni Pleis, dijan pleis weya aibin meigim seikridwan blanga weshipbat mi. En pipul ebriweya garra meigimbat fan en rabishim dijan pleis.

“Dijan Serramoni Pleis im brabli gudwan tudei, bat bambai wen ai libum dijan pleis, ebribodi hu wokpas garra gedim shok en askim, ‘Wotfo YAWEI bin dum dijan langa det Serramoni Pleis en dijan kantri?’

Najalot pipul garra tok, ‘Dumaji deibin gibit bekboun langa YAWEI det trubala God blanga olabat hubin bringimat olabat grengrenfathamob brom Ijip. Deibin bulurrumbat najalot drimin en weshipbat olabat. Blanga tharran na YAWEI bin bringimap ol dislot nogudbala ting langa olabat.’” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.
